title: China tells Israel to stop 'forced establishment' of West Bank settlements
detail: China called on Israel to stop what it described as the forced establishment of settlements in the occupied West Bank, according to a Straits Times report published October 16, 2026.

media.caption: China says Israel should stop its forced establishment of West Bank settlements

title: Settler attacks during olive harvest injure at least six Palestinians
detail: Settler attacks during the West Bank olive harvest injured at least six Palestinians and set olive trees on fire, according to a news report published October 16, 2026.
